summary: Library opposes any reduction or elimination of the E‑Rate program, citing its essential role in serving patrons.

claims.requested_action: Do not reduce or eliminate the federal E‑Rate program
claims.argument: The library argues that cutting E‑Rate funding would severely limit its ability to serve patrons.
claims.evidence_quote: Reducing the e-rate will severely affect our library's ability to serve our patrons.  Do not reduce or eliminate the federal e-rate program
